Preserve its exact overall arrangement and exactly EIGHT horses plus ONE blue-robed herder: the low-headed white horse and bending black horse overlapping at far left foreground; behind them one rear-facing dark chestnut, one left-facing ochre-brown horse, one lowered-head white horse; near center a right-facing dapple gray horse; just left of the huge willow trunk a frontal light dun horse; at right one grazing chestnut-and-white pinto beside the single herder. Keep the dominant leaning ancient willow at roughly 64% image width, its long sparse drooping branches arching over the middle; rugged low ochre rocks and sparse autumn plants at left, shallow uneven earth and sparse grasses foreground. Upper half quiet misty warm gray-beige distance with restrained blue-gray atmospheric layers, no invented lake, no mountains or buildings. Style: sophisticated believable 3D game environment rendered with delicate Chinese court-painting color, subtle brush detail, soft physically plausible volume, warm ochre earth, muted gray-green willow leaves, restrained autumn red leaves at far left. Calm broad diffuse daylight, soft contact shadows, no dramatic sunset, no shafts or excessive fog. Preserve the intimacy and flat panoramic rhythm while adding modest spatial depth and sculptural anatomy. No silk weave or crack texture baked on subjects, no sepia filter smothering white horses, no text, no labels, no UI, no frames, no additional animals or people. Entire composition comfortably inside image with no missing herder. This is the final atmosphere concept, not a technical layout sheet.

Tail hangs with a subtle backward curve separated from hind legs. Entire animal uncropped with generous 12% margins. Soft neutral diffuse studio light on a seamless light gray background; faint contact shadow only. Natural short coat microtexture, anatomically credible equine knees, hocks and fetlocks, dark gray hooves, restrained material highlights. Not a racehorse, not oversized draft horse, not cartoon. No saddle, no tack, no person, no scenery, no floor pedestal, no labels, no multiple views, no text. Absolutely no silk canvas weave, cracks or painting substrate on the horse. The result is a neutral modeling asset, not a sepia painting.
